title: Adversarial review panel seat return
description: What one seat of the review panel returns to the conductor. A frame, a verdict, and citation-bearing findings — never a file dump and never a summary of the diff.

expert.description: The seat identifier. Must be distinct from every other seat in the same panel — three returns from one frame is one opinion, not a panel.

frame.description: The single question this seat refused to leave, e.g. "what does this change let an untrusted caller do that it could not do before?".

verdict.description: The seat's overall judgement. The accepted vocabulary is DATA in harness/disciplines.toml, not fixed here.

findings.description: What the seat found from its frame. An empty array is a legitimate result and means the frame found nothing — it is not the same as not having looked.

claim.description: One terse assertion about a specific defect or risk, NOT a file excerpt and NOT a restatement of the change.

severity.description: Maps onto the evidence.json finding severity the conductor will land this under.

citations.description: Where the claim is grounded — path plus optional line range and symbol, never pasted content.

lines.description: A line or range, e.g. "42" or "42-58".

falsifier.description: What observation would show this finding is wrong. A finding nobody can disprove is an opinion.

out_of_frame.description: Things the seat noticed but that belong to another seat's frame. Recorded so they are not lost, and so the seat is not tempted to leave its own frame.
